question: Which technology is associated with providing high-speed wireless data transmission for communication devices?
solution:
The correct answer is __**LTE**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **LTE** (Long-Term Evolution) is associated with providing high-speed wireless data transmission for mobile devices.
 
• LTE is a standard for wireless broadband communication for mobile devices and data terminals.
 
• It increases the capacity and speed using a different radio interface together with core network improvements.
